summary.name: Meshy
summary.one_liner: Meshy is an AI 3D model generator that turns text prompts or images into 3D models that can be printed, used in games, or refined further.
use_cases: create game assets from text or concept art
summary.what_it_does: Meshy generates 3D models from a text description or an uploaded image such as a photo, sketch, or concept art, reportedly in under a minute. It generates full PBR texture sets (albedo, normal, metallic, roughness) and offers an HD texture option. Auto-rigging supports humanoid and quadruped characters, with 600+ motion presets listed. Low Poly Mode produces clean topology with an adjustable poly count. Models can be exported as FBX, GLB, OBJ, USDZ, STL, or 3MF, and the page says models are watertight and manifold with a printability check and auto-repair before slicing.
notable: Exports print-ready meshes (watertight, manifold) with auto-split for multi-part and multi-color printing
Auto-rigging with 600+ motion presets for humanoid and quadruped characters
MCP server installable into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients
caveats: Page describes a free tier with no credit card required, but the paid tiers and limits are not detailed on the page
Print-on-demand service is mentioned for users without a printer, with no pricing given
Marketing claims such as generation speed and user counts are not independently verified on the page
